text:
lucas-partners: quick debrief — GCP marketplace listing error this morning. partner engineer pinged support, but the issue got routed into our general queue and sat for 25m. partners upset.

tara-se: thanks for flagging. we need a partner-first triage path for marketplace + SI partner integrations. idea: dedicated partner PD escalation with separate channel creation for any partner-impacting incident.

nina-sre: agreed. propose clear severity mapping for partner incidents (partner-sev1 = production customer impact across >25 customers; partner-sev2 = single-customer outage or failing publish flow; partner-sev3 = non-customer-facing listing issues).

raj-eng: can we bake detection into alerts? sample rule:

```yaml
if alert.source == "marketplace" and alert.metric == "listing_publish_failures" and rate > 5/min:
  route: partner-pd
  create: partners-warroom
```

this would short-circuit general ops queue.

chris-ops: I'll add routing in PD and filter rules in our alertmanager. also adding a "partner-liaison" role to the war room template so biz/dev gets cc'd.

lucas-partners: partners want a single liaison and an expectation doc. small one-pager: where to open ticket, who to ping (PD id & slack), expected ack times. can we commit internal targets?

tara-se: internal targets: ack within 10m for partner-sev1 when paged; 30m for partner-sev2. we'll put those in the playbook but mark as "internal SLA".

nina-sre: SRE will take 10m ack for partner-sev1 if pager triggers. we'll also maintain a war room template with runbook links and a postmortem checklist that includes partner notification timeline. link template: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/partner-escalation-template

oncall-bot: ALERT: new oncall rotation deployed. Primary oncall: nina-sre until 2026-04-04 07:00 UTC.

raj-eng: for SI integrations (webhooks, callbacks) add a troubleshooting checklist to run in war room: 1) replay webhooks 2) verify token expiry 3) check callback endpoints in partner portal 4) check NAT/firewall logs. I'll draft.

chris-ops: PR incoming: PD escalation maps + alertmanager filters. Example snippet for PD rules:

```yaml
partner_escalation:
  sev1: pages: [sre-pd, partner-se-pd, eng-lead-pd]
  sev2: pages: [partner-se-pd, eng-pd]
  sev3: notify: [partners-channel]
```

I'll link PR in a bit: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/pagerduty/pulls/89

lucas-partners: can we also define when we create a public partner-facing war room vs private customer-only war room? partners sometimes prefer inbound transparency. suggest: default: partner-facing unless customer requests privacy.

tara-se: +1. add a communication RACI: partner-liaison posts partner updates, eng lead posts technical update, SRE posts incident status and resolution notes.

nina-sre: also adding a rapid checklist to minimize blast radius: disable new listing jobs, put publisher queue into retry-backoff, temporary redirect traffic to healthy registry. will add runbook steps.

marketplace-bot: NOTE: marketplace provider contact (GCP) stored in partner contacts doc. Use /partner-contact gcp-marketplace to retrieve.

chris-ops: next steps: I'll push PD + alert changes, raj will add SI checklist, tara & lucas will draft partner one-pager and outreach email for partners. nina will create the war room template & postmortem template. sync tomorrow 9:30am PT?

lucas-partners: yes please. thanks team — want this live before next partner release. :rocket:
